text: Day four of building the first TikTok cat town... and we have a problem.
Two hundred sixty one of you followed. That is two hundred sixty one houses.
But four hundred seventy nine of you liked. That is four hundred seventy nine cats.
Four hundred seventy nine cats. Two hundred sixty one houses. Two hundred eighteen cats have no home!
Tilly said: build an art studio, and the cats build Mango a statue!
And the cats with no home? They work here now.
Look Mango... they made you a statue!
But they still need homes. Every follow builds one more house.
Can we get every cat a home?
